verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only a human-facing web portal (bizfile Online), mail and in-person submission, and entity-linked web User Access. It shows no system accounts, transmitter program, batch-filing provider channel, or published enrollment path for software to transact. The only related item is a passing reference to Bulk data requestors, which suggests a data feed but documents neither a transactional channel nor how to enroll. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the filing portal sits behind bot management.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
